editorMock.caption: The Donkey Cut editor with a finished project open: generated media in the side panel, clips and music on the timeline, and the AI chat that assembled them.

sidePanel.renderNote: Renders take a minute or two. Keep editing while it runs.

aiPanel.placeholder: Ask about your video, or tell me what to change… @ references media

posters.name: City poster series
posters.prompt: Hand-painted travel poster, PARIS — woman in a trench coat crossing the street, Eiffel Tower behind, café awnings, 'Live the romance' in red script
posters.clipNewYork: New York — Rise above the city
posters.chat1: Make two hand-painted travel posters — Paris and New York, same woman crossing the street in both.
posters.chat2: Here are the two posters, matched palette and typography:
posters.chat3: Animate them — she walks, slow camera drift, keep the painted texture. Then cut them together with captions and music.
posters.chat4: Rendered two 4s clips and assembled the timeline with captions and a waltz. Want a different track?

railway.name: The Railway Mystery
railway.prompt: Franco-Belgian comic style, early-1900s animation with film grain: a steam train races a cliffside railway through a mountain canyon; a cloaked figure rides the carriage roof; a boy on a bicycle gives chase
railway.chat1: Storyboard a 1920s comic-style chase: a mysterious figure on a steam train, a kid chasing on a bicycle through a canyon.
railway.chat2: Three shots: 1) the train threading the canyon, 2) the cloaked figure steadying himself on the roof, 3) the boy pedaling hard beside the tracks.
railway.chat3: Animate all three in that ligne-claire style.
railway.chat4: Rendered the three shots and cut them with a brass-and-strings score:
railway.chat5: Add a train whistle when it clears the tunnel, and gravel under the bicycle.
railway.chat6: Placed both on the effects track and mixed them under the score. Want the cut tightened where the train enters the tunnel?

mason.name: Cartoon

mason.chat2:
